column22: The original claim conflated MauPass e-KYC authentication access for foreigners (a login/verification feature using passport documents) with actual inclusion in the population register. The Civil Status Act s.8B limits the Central Population Database to persons whose birth is registered in Mauritius or who become citizens; non-citizens, including permanent residents, are instead recorded in a wholly separate 'Register of Non-Citizens' maintained by the Director-General of Immigration under the Immigration Act 2022 s.32. Downgraded to Value Code 1 (None), as non-citizen residents are not included in the population register itself. Flagging as worth a light human sanity-check given the narrow possibility that Mauritius-born children of non-citizen residents may appear via civil registration.
